summary: Software Engineer with professional experience developing and maintaining full-stack applications using Java, Spring Boot, React, TypeScript, and JavaScript. Strong exposure to Agile development, code reviews, version control, and real-world software engineering practices.

Redesigned multi-provider dispatch logic to improve fallback scheduling, ensuring secondary transportation providers are engaged only after primary-provider search criteria are exhausted and eliminating redundant scheduling operations.

Applied the Strategy design pattern to OTP generation and extended an OAuth2/AWS Cognito authentication flow to handle identity-provider challenge sequences, improving authentication flexibility across environments.

Contributed to relational data modelling for distinct enterprise and retail account types and implemented the associated customer-management interface using React and TypeScript with typed API contracts.
Extended backend services with PostgreSQL schema migrations and AWS S3 presigned-URL file uploads, adding automated tests to validate API and controller behaviour.
Integrated a third-party payment gateway into a patient-facing payment workflow and refactored duplicated filtering logic into reusable components across multiple billing views.

Investigated and resolved production issues across frontend and backend services while collaborating with senior developers and architects through an Agile development workflow using Jira, GitHub, and Bitbucket.
